title: Native Carry Geometry
description: Lean 4 formalization from positional quotient-residue geometry and carry mass to quadratic amplitude rigidity and one native centered-bracket operator. Real pairs and complex numbers are faithful coordinates of the same mass-built state and resultant, with the same zero locus; sigma is an ambient quadratic-norm deformation coordinate. Release v0.4.0 also includes an explicitly audited lossless vertical reconstruction and radial readout transport.
